title: 第十二章 深夜夜谈的传说第十一章 第一课 魔法平衡木
lines: 夜色像被墨汁浸透的绸缎，缓缓覆盖住幻境学院的尖顶塔楼与绿茵操场。魔法路灯次第亮起，淡金色的光晕在石板路上晕开，将晚归学子的影子拉得老长。
林澈推开宿舍楼307室的木门时，正赶上凯把最后一块烤魔猪排塞进嘴里，油星溅在他胸前的火焰纹章上，那是魔法国战士家族的标志，此刻正随着他的咀嚼微微发亮。
“你可算回来了，”凯含糊不清地说，用手背抹了把嘴，“刚去食堂帮你打了份晚餐，再晚点就要被巡逻的风元素守卫收走了。”
林澈道谢，将怀里抱着的几本厚重古籍放在桌上——那是他刚从图书馆借来的，关于空间魔法基础理论的书。靠窗的书桌前，苏璃正借着月光给一盆银叶藤浇水，叶片在她指尖拂过时泛起细碎的绿光。
“月姬还没回来吗？”林澈问。
苏璃摇摇头，指尖在银叶藤的卷须上轻轻一点：“她说去镜像馆再练会儿，今天的镜像折射术总出错。”
话音刚落，门锁“咔哒”一声转动，月姬抱着一本封面磨损的羊皮书走进来，斗篷边缘还沾着几片夜露打湿的草叶。她脸色有些苍白，放下书时，手指不经意间碰倒了桌上的琉璃盏，里面的清水晃出一圈涟漪，映出她眼底一闪而过的暗紫色。
“怎么了？”凯最先察觉到不对，往嘴里塞面包的动作顿住了，“镜像馆的镜子又出问题了？”
幻境学院的镜像馆是镜幻国学子的专属练习场，馆内布满能映照人心的“真实镜”，但最近总有些镜子会在深夜透出异常的光。月姬坐下，指尖无意识地摩挲着羊皮书的边缘，那本书封面上没有任何文字，只有一个由无数细小镜片组成的螺旋图案。
“不是练习的问题，”她声音很轻，像是怕惊扰了什么，“我刚才在镜像馆看到……第三面墙最角落的那面‘尘封镜’，它自己亮起来了。”
宿舍里瞬间安静下来。尘封镜是镜像馆里最古老的镜子，据说从学院建成时就存在，镜面蒙着一层洗不掉的灰雾，从来没人能从里面看到任何影像，连镜幻国最有天赋的导师都不行。
苏璃放下水壶，银叶藤的卷须轻轻缠上她的手腕，像是在安抚：“它……映出什么了吗？”
月姬深吸一口气，像是在回忆某个模糊的梦：“一片黑色的森林，树杈上挂着发光的锁链，还有……一个穿白色长袍的人，背对着我站在森林中央。他周围的地面上，刻着和我们今天在预备班教室黑板上看到的一样的星图碎片。”
林澈的心猛地一跳。今天下午的预备班课上，导师确实在黑板上投影过一块残缺的星图，说是从古籍库失窃的星图中残留的拓片，让他们试着分析坐标。当时他就觉得那星图的线条很熟悉，像是某种空间节点的排列，只是一时没想起来在哪里见过。
“白色长袍？”凯皱起眉，手指在膝盖上敲出急促的节奏，“幻灵国的祭司才穿白袍，但祭司从不踏足镜幻国的镜像馆。而且……”他顿了顿，声音压低了些，“我祖父说过，百年前守护秘境的人，穿的就是绣着星图的白袍。”
“秘境守护者？”苏璃的银叶藤突然剧烈地抖动了一下，叶片上的绿光变得忽明忽暗，“我小时候在灵都国的皇家图书馆看过一本禁书，里面说秘境守护者不是一个人，是一群能和秘境沟通的魔法师，他们的血脉里藏着开启秘境的钥匙。但后来……”
“后来他们都失踪了，”月姬接过话头，羊皮书在她膝头微微发烫，“镜幻国的传说里说，他们是被自己守护的秘境吞噬了，因为他们试图用秘境的力量做不该做的事。”
“什么事？”凯追问。
月姬摇摇头：“传说没说清楚，只提到‘平衡被打破’，还说秘境会在‘四元素共鸣，镜像照出真相’时再次开启，到时候失踪的守护者会以‘影子’的形态回来，向世人讨还代价。”
宿舍里的空气仿佛凝固了，窗外的风声穿过走廊，带着点呜咽似的回响。林澈走到窗边，推开一条缝隙，夜风吹进带来草木的清香，远处的钟楼在月光下投出细长的影子，像一根指向天空的手指。
“你们觉不觉得，”他忽然开口，目光落在窗外那片被魔法光晕笼罩的小树林上，“学院里关于秘境的传说，好像不止一种？”
他想起昨天去图书馆时，在禁书区的角落里听到两个穿黑袍的学长对话，提到“暗影”正在找“第一把钥匙”，还说“元素秘境的入口就在试炼场地下”。当时他以为是学生间的恶作剧传说，没放在心上，现在想来，那些话和月姬看到的镜像、导师展示的星图碎片，似乎隐隐能串成一条线。
苏璃的银叶藤突然朝着门口的方向伸展，叶片簌簌作响。她轻“咦”了一声，指尖凝聚起一点淡绿色的光：“外面有人。”
凯立刻站起身，手按在腰间的火焰符牌上——那是他父亲给他的信物，能在危急时刻召唤出护体火焰。月姬将羊皮书紧紧抱在怀里，镜面螺旋图案在她掌心的温度下泛起微光。林澈退后一步，指尖无意识地划过桌面，空气中的空间元素开始随着他的呼吸轻轻震颤。
宿舍门没有被推开，只有一道极轻的脚步声从门外经过，像是故意放轻了脚步。过了一会儿，凯走到门边，透过门缝往外看，走廊上空空荡荡，只有魔法路灯的光晕在地面上投下规律的光斑。
“没人，”他皱着眉转身，“但我刚才好像闻到了……硫磺的味道。”
魔法国的火焰魔法确实常带着硫磺气息，但凯家族的火焰术是纯净的龙炎，绝不会有这种味道。月姬突然想起什么，翻开膝头的羊皮书，里面的空白页上不知何时浮现出几行用银粉写的字，像是刚被人写上去的：
content_en:
The night is like silk soaked in ink, slowly covering the spire tower and green playground of Fantasy Academy. The magic street lamps lit up one after another, and the pale golden light spread on the stone road, making the shadows of the students returning late grow long.
When Lin Che pushed open the wooden door of Room 307 of the dormitory building, she was just in time to catch Kai stuffing the last piece of grilled demon pork chop into his mouth. Oil stars splashed on the fire emblem on his chest. It was the symbol of the Magic Kingdom's warrior family, and it was shining slightly as he chewed it.
"You're back," Kai said vaguely, wiping his mouth with the back of his hand. "I just went to the cafeteria to buy you a dinner. If you are later, you will be taken away by the patrolling wind element guards."
Lin Che thanked him and put several thick ancient books in his arms on the table - they were books on the basic theory of space magic that he had just borrowed from the library. At the desk by the window, Su Li was watering a pot of silver-leaf vine in the moonlight, and the leaves glowed with tiny green light when her fingertips brushed against it.
"Isn't Yue Ji back yet?" Lin Che asked.
Su Li shook her head and tapped her fingertips on the tendrils of the silver leaf vine: "She said she would go to the Mirror Hall to practice some more. Today's mirror refraction technique kept making mistakes."
As soon as he finished speaking, the door lock clicked, and Yue Ji walked in holding a parchment book with a worn cover. There were still a few blades of grass wet with night dew on the edges of her cloak. Her face was a little pale, and when she put down the book, her fingers inadvertently knocked over the glass cup on the table. The clear water in it made a circle of ripples, reflecting the dark purple flashing in her eyes.
"What's wrong?" Kai was the first to notice something was wrong. He paused while stuffing bread into his mouth. "Is there something wrong with the mirror in the Mirror Hall again?"
The Mirror Hall of Mirage Academy is an exclusive training ground for Mirror Fantasy students. The hall is full of "real mirrors" that can reflect people's hearts, but recently, some mirrors always emit abnormal light late at night. Yue Ji sat down and unconsciously rubbed the edge of the parchment with her fingertips. There was no text on the cover of the book, only a spiral pattern composed of countless tiny lenses.
"It's not a matter of practice," her voice was very soft, as if she was afraid of disturbing something, "I just saw it in the Mirror Hall... the 'dusty mirror' in the corner of the third wall, it lit up by itself."
The dormitory instantly became quiet. The dust-covered mirror is the oldest mirror in the Mirror Hall. It is said to have existed since the academy was built. The mirror is covered with a layer of gray fog that cannot be washed away. No one has ever been able to see any image from it, not even the most talented instructor in Mirror Fantasy Kingdom.
Su Li put down the kettle, and the tendrils of the silver leaf vine gently wrapped around her wrist, as if to comfort her: "Does it... reflect anything?"
Yue Ji took a deep breath, as if recalling a vague dream: "A black forest, with glowing chains hanging on the tree branches, and... a man in white robes, standing in the middle of the forest with his back to me. On the ground around him, there are engraved fragments of the same star map that we saw on the blackboard in the preparatory class classroom today."
Lin Che's heart skipped a beat. In the preparatory class this afternoon, the instructor did project a fragmented star map on the blackboard, saying it was a rubbing leftover from a star map stolen from the ancient book library, and asked them to try to analyze the coordinates. At that time, he felt that the lines of the star map were very familiar, like some kind of arrangement of space nodes, but he couldn't remember where he had seen them before.
"White robes?" Kai frowned, tapping his fingers on his knees in a rapid rhythm, "Only the priests of the Phantom Kingdom wear white robes, but the priests never set foot in the mirror hall of the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom. And..." He paused and lowered his voice, "My grandfather said that those who guarded the secret realm a hundred years ago wore white robes embroidered with star charts."
"Guardian of the secret realm?" Su Li's silver-leaf vine suddenly shook violently, and the green light on the leaves flickered. "When I was a child, I read a forbidden book in the Royal Library of Lingdu Kingdom. It said that the guardians of the secret realm are not just one person, but a group of magicians who can communicate with the secret realm. The key to the secret realm is hidden in their blood. But then..."
"They all disappeared later," Yue Ji took over, the parchment slightly hot on her knees. "The legend of Jing Huan Kingdom says that they were swallowed up by the secret realm they guarded because they tried to use the power of the secret realm to do things they shouldn't do."
"What's the matter?" Kai asked.
Yue Ji shook her head: "The legend didn't make it clear. It only mentioned that 'the balance is broken', and also said that the secret realm will be opened again when 'the four elements resonate and the mirror image reveals the truth'. At that time, the missing guardian will come back in the form of a 'shadow' to demand repayment from the world."
The air in the dormitory seemed to be frozen, and the sound of wind outside the window passed through the corridor, echoing like a whimper. Lin Che walked to the window and opened a gap. The night wind blew in, bringing in the fragrance of grass and trees. The bell tower in the distance cast a slender shadow in the moonlight, like a finger pointing to the sky.
"Do you think," he suddenly said, his eyes falling on the small forest shrouded in magic halo outside the window, "there seems to be more than one legend about the secret realm in the academy?"
He remembered that when he went to the library yesterday, he heard a conversation between two seniors in black robes in the corner of the forbidden book area. They mentioned that "Shadow" was looking for the "first key" and said that "the entrance to the secret realm of elements is under the trial venue." At that time, he thought it was a prank legend among students and didn't take it to heart. Now that he thinks about it, those words, the mirror image Yue Ji saw and the star map fragments displayed by the instructor seemed to be vaguely connected.
Su Li's silver-leaf vine suddenly stretched towards the door, its leaves rustling. She said softly, and a light green light gathered on her fingertips: "There is someone outside."
Kai immediately stood up and placed his hand on the flame talisman on his waist - it was a token given to him by his father, which could summon protective flames in critical moments. Yue Ji held the parchment tightly in her arms, the mirrored spiral pattern shimmering under the warmth of her palm. Lin Che took a step back and unconsciously traced the table with her fingertips. The spatial elements in the air began to vibrate gently with his breathing.
The dormitory door was not pushed open, only a very light footsteps passed by the door, as if the steps were deliberately light. After a while, Kai walked to the door and looked out through the crack in the door. The corridor was empty except for the halo of the magic street lamp, which cast regular spots of light on the ground.
"No one," he frowned and turned around, "but I seemed to smell... the smell of sulfur just now."
The flame magic of the Magic Kingdom does often smell of sulfur, but the Kai family's fire magic is pure dragon flame and will never smell like this. Yue Ji suddenly remembered something and opened the parchment on her lap. On the blank pages inside, a few lines of words written in silver powder appeared at some point, as if they had just been written on them:
title_en: Chapter 12 The Legend of Late Night Talk Chapter 11 Lesson 1 Magic Balance Beam
